name: Snipes Farm, Nursery and Golf
description: In Morrisville, PA, Snipes Farm, Nursery and Golf grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
